WITH rating_metrics AS (
  SELECT
    rating,
    AVG(length) AS avg_length,
    AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_per_day_price
  FROM film
  GROUP BY rating
),
cross_rating_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price
  FROM rating_metrics
)
SELECT
  AVG(rm.avg_length) AS avg_of_avg_lengths,
  AVG(rm.avg_per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_price,
  AVG(rm.avg_per_day_price - crm.mean_per_day_price) AS avg_excess_per_day_price
FROM rating_metrics rm
CROSS JOIN cross_rating_mean crm
WHERE rm.avg_per_day_price > crm.mean_per_day_price;
